classification_rule: Absolute Spearman >= 0.80 AND absolute Pearson >= 0.70 AND stable sign in >=75% robustness windows AND conditional relationship adds negligible information.

Absolute Spearman <= 0.20 AND absolute Pearson <= 0.20 AND nonlinear dependence not supported after correction.
